methods.name: posterior sampling
methods.description: Sampling where the reference molecule is provided to the input encoder.

methods.name: variability factor scaling
methods.description: Scales the standard deviations used to sample the latent space using a variability factor denoted λvar (z′=µ+λvarσz).

methods.name: prior-posterior interpolation
methods.description: Controls the amount of bias towards the reference molecule by linearly interpolating distribution parameters between prior and posterior according to a bias factor λbias.

methods.name: conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE)
methods.description: Generative model where an input branch encodes the full complex density to a probabilistic latent space and a conditional branch encodes the receptor density, with a decoder generating output ligand density from a sampled latent vector combined with a conditional vector

methods.name: atom typing and gridding
methods.description: Operations that convert a docked protein-ligand complex into an atomic density representation

methods.name: atom fitting and bond adding
methods.description: Converts generated output ligand density into a final 3D molecular structure

methods.name: RDkit sanitization
methods.description: Checks valency constraints and attempts to Kekulize aromatic bonds to determine molecular validity.

methods.name: Universal Force Field (UFF) minimization
methods.description: Relaxes internal bond lengths and angles of generated molecules in the context of the binding site, used to measure internal energy and root-mean-squared-deviation (RMSD).

methods.name: Vina minimization and scoring
methods.description: Minimization and scoring of real and generated molecules with respect to the receptor, performed using gnina.

methods.name: CNN affinity prediction
methods.description: Estimates binding affinity of minimized structures using an ensemble of CNN scoring functions trained on the CrossDocked2020 data set, performed using gnina.

methods.name: Atom fitting algorithm
methods.description: Combines iterative atom detection with gradient descent to find a set of atoms that best fits a reference density grid

methods.name: Steric clash loss
methods.description: An additional loss term that minimizes steric clash in terms of the overlap between the generated ligand density and the receptor density by summing across grid channels and multiplying receptor and ligand density at each point.

methods.name: Combined loss function
methods.description: Combines reconstruction loss, KL divergence loss, and steric clash loss with weighted terms: L = λrecon Lrecon + λKL LKL + λsteric Lsteric.

methods.name: U-Net skip connections
methods.description: included between the convolutional features of the conditional encoder and the decoder to enhance the processing of receptor context

methods.name: Spectral normalization
methods.description: applied to all learnable parameters during training

methods.name: combinatorial docking procedure
methods.description: Each ligand was re-docked to its known receptor and cross-docked to every other receptor with a similar pocket
